comment: ArchiMate/TOGAF terms like "capability" and "application component" are used from page 8 onward, but the notation isn't actually explained until page 42 (Section 3.1). Chapters 1, 2, and 4 are meant for non-technical readers too (ministries, donors, procurement), so this makes the early chapters harder to follow than they need to be.
